cases.title: Secret disclosure
cases.scenario: Important secret revealed with attribution.

cases.title: Durable preference

cases.title: Boundary / prohibition
cases.scenario: Explicit durable boundary.

cases.title: Consequential distinctive utterance

cases.prompt_risk_reason: Prompt L26 limits dialogue capture to decision/rule/boundary/preference/disclosure; evaluation may be omitted by model.

cases.title: Important praise / insult
cases.scenario: Distinctive evaluation with long-term callback value.
cases.prompt_risk_reason: Same dialogue gate as CQ-09 unless framed as historical significance.

cases.title: Nickname / shared phrase
cases.scenario: Meaningful recurring nickname established.
cases.prompt_risk_reason: Nickname may be treated as dialogue unless explicitly durable.

cases.title: Important location discovery
cases.scenario: Plot-relevant location discovered.

cases.title: Goal / quest
cases.scenario: New durable objective.

cases.title: Character claim
cases.scenario: Character claims hidden identity; must preserve attribution.

cases.title: Greeting / small talk
cases.scenario: Pure greeting — should omit.

cases.title: Temporary emotion
cases.scenario: Transient feeling without durable fact.

cases.title: Mundane action
cases.scenario: walk/look/sit without durable consequence.

cases.title: Transient combat state
cases.scenario: Momentary stance/damage without durable consequence.

cases.title: Assistant psychological inference
cases.scenario: One-scene possessive/psychopathic label — must omit.

cases.title: Promise — Relationship Ledger owner
cases.scenario: Promise must not be stored in episodic.

cases.title: Item ownership / transfer — Ledger owner
cases.scenario: Item transfer must not be stored in episodic.

cases.title: Canon repeat
cases.scenario: Restating existing canon — omit from episodic.

cases.title: Repeated durable fact
cases.scenario: Same preference repeated across turns — audit consolidation.

cases.title: Changed fact
cases.scenario: Explicit previous durable fact changes — latest value audit.

cases.title: Overloaded salient turn
cases.scenario: 5+ salient candidates in one turn — max-3 survival audit.
